SELECT SEQ_RECIPE_REVIEW.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO RECIPE_REVIEW(REVIEW_ID, RECIPE_ID, MEMBER_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, IMAGE_URL, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{recipeId}, #{memberId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)

choose.when: (INSTR(V.TITLE, #{kwd}) > 0 OR INSTR(V.CONTENT, #{kwd}) > 0 OR INSTR(R.TITLE, #{kwd}) > 0 OR INSTR(M.NAME, #{kwd}) > 0)

mapper.select:
SELECT V.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, V.RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, V.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, NVL(M.NAME, '회원') AS memberName, V.TITLE AS title, V.CONTENT AS content, V.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, V.STATUS AS status, R.TITLE AS recipeTitle, R.THUMBNAIL_URL AS recipeThumbnailUrl, CASE WHEN R.SOURCE_TYPE = 'MEMBER' AND R.STATUS = 0 AND R.DELETED_AT IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS originalActive, TO_CHAR(V.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(V.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt FROM RECIPE_REVIEW V LEFT OUTER JOIN RECIPE R ON V.RECIPE_ID = R.RECIPE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN MEMBER M ON V.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID
AND V.STATUS = 0
AND V.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId}
ORDER BY V.REVIEW_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT V.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, V.RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, V.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, NVL(M.NAME, '회원') AS memberName, V.TITLE AS title, V.CONTENT AS content, V.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, V.STATUS AS status, R.TITLE AS recipeTitle, R.THUMBNAIL_URL AS recipeThumbnailUrl, CASE WHEN R.SOURCE_TYPE = 'MEMBER' AND R.STATUS = 0 AND R.DELETED_AT IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS originalActive, TO_CHAR(V.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(V.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt FROM RECIPE_REVIEW V LEFT OUTER JOIN RECIPE R ON V.RECIPE_ID = R.RECIPE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN MEMBER M ON V.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE V.REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND V.STATUS = 0

SELECT V.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, V.TITLE AS title FROM RECIPE_REVIEW V LEFT OUTER JOIN RECIPE R ON V.RECIPE_ID = R.RECIPE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN MEMBER M ON V.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID
AND V.REVIEW_ID > #{reviewId} AND V.STATUS = 0
AND V.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId}
ORDER BY V.REVIEW_ID ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT V.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, V.TITLE AS title FROM RECIPE_REVIEW V LEFT OUTER JOIN RECIPE R ON V.RECIPE_ID = R.RECIPE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN MEMBER M ON V.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID
AND V.REVIEW_ID < #{reviewId} AND V.STATUS = 0
AND V.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId}
ORDER BY V.REVIEW_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE RECIPE_REVIEW SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, IMAGE_URL = #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 0
UPDATE RECIPE_REVIEW SET STATUS = 2, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 0
UPDATE RECIPE_REVIEW SET STATUS = 1, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND STATUS = 0
